name: winmote
description: Windows desktop automation tools for Codex via the Winmote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Control the local Windows desktop from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Winmote adds MCP tools for Windows desktop automation: screenshots, UI Automation, OCR, mouse and keyboard input, window management, clipboard, taskbar, displays, notifications, and target-based UI interaction.
defaultPrompt: Open a browser and navigate with Winmote.
Click a numbered UI target on screen.
